title: Uruguayan Crisp Fish Ceviche
description: A refreshing Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring crisp fish marinated in a zesty ceviche sauce.

ingredients.name: Fresh mackerel
ingredients.notes: Crisp and firm fish works best

instructions: 1. Cut the mackerel into 1-inch pieces and place in a shallow dish.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together lime juice, red onion, cilantro, aji amarillo pepper, salt, and black pepper.
3. Pour the marinade over the mackerel and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Just before serving, garnish with mixed greens and serve immediately.
5. Note: Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature before preparing the dish.
